snippet.title: Lost In The Roots Story Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
The devs at Trioskaz are getting ready to release their new game, Lost in the Roots, very soon. The events take place in the same world as No, I'm not a Human, the one that came out in 2025 and became super popular. In Lost in the Roots, we'll also get to know a character named Jakob way better, along with his complicated relationship with a girl named Trisha.

A mysterious atmosphere, puzzles, an incredible vibe, and more. And as part of the event, the devs have prepared a really nice surprise for fans: the game's characters will be fully voiced!

Wishlist Lost in the Roots now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2872240/Lost_in_the_Roots/
